title: PRC Civil Code Article 470
text: 合同的内容由当事人约定，一般包括当事人、标的、数量、质量、价款或者报酬、履行期限地点方式、违约责任和争议解决等条款。
source: Yongjia County People's Congress legal information page
english_gloss: The parties agree the contents of a contract, generally including the parties, subject matter, quantity, quality, price or remuneration, performance period/place/method, breach liability, and dispute resolution.

title: PRC Civil Code Article 510
text: 合同生效后，质量、价款或者报酬、履行地点等内容没有约定或者约定不明确的，可以协议补充；不能达成补充协议的，按照合同相关条款或者交易习惯确定。
source: Yongjia County People's Congress legal information page
english_gloss: After a contract takes effect, unclear or missing quality, price/remuneration or place of performance terms may be supplemented by agreement; otherwise the relevant contract terms or transaction practices apply.

title: PRC Civil Code Article 596
text: 买卖合同的内容一般包括标的物名称、数量、质量、价款、履行期限地点方式、包装方式、检验标准和方法、结算方式等条款。
source: Yongjia County People's Congress legal information page
english_gloss: A sale contract generally includes the goods name, quantity, quality, price, performance period/place/method, packaging, inspection standards/methods and settlement method.
